recentItems.title: China condemns Taiwan presence at Pacific Islands forum
recentItems.description:
China said on Tuesday (September 1) that Taiwan is in no position to attend the Pacific Islands Forum in Palau and its presence has brought disgrace on itself.

    Officials from the democratically ruled island attended the group's opening ceremony on Monday (August 31), prompting China's special envoy for Pacific island affairs Qian Bo to warn of "consequences."

    China views Taiwan as its own territory, and China-Taiwan tensions have featured prominently at the meeting, which is intended to demonstrate regional unity.

    China has gradually whittled away the number of Pacific Island countries with formal ties to Taipei, with only three remaining — Palau, Tuvalu and the Marshall Islands.

     Australia, New Zealand and the United States have long considered the South Pacific to fall within their sphere of influence.

     In the latest sign of that effort, New Zealand and the U.S. said in a joint statement released on Tuesday during the summit that they would jointly fund a major upgrade of a World War Two port on a Cook Islands' atoll.

(Camera: Wang Shubing, Editing and Production: Nicoco Chan)

recentItems.title: Robin idinaing ang pitong oras na biyahe sa NLEX dahil sa baha sa San Simon exit
recentItems.description:
Sa gitna ng pagtalakay ng mga senador sa plenaryo nitong Martes (Setyembre 1) kaugnay ng pagbuo ng flood control masterplan, idinaing ni Sen. Robin Padilla ang naranasan nitong halos pitong oras na biyahe sa NLEX nitong Lunes bunsod ng mabagal na daloy ng trapiko sa San Simon exit dahil sa baha.

Sang-ayon ang senador sa planong pagbuo ng nasabing masterplan at sinabing maghahain din siya ng panukalang batas upang maiwasan ang pagtatayo ng anumang imprastraktura sa low-lying areas.

recentItems.title: How a 68-year-old pedicab driver cares for 6 dogs amid heavy rains in Manila
recentItems.description:
In front of an empty building along Taft Avenue lies a green pedicab that houses Tatay Carlos Orit and his six dogs.

Orit has not pedaled for a while. He has been staying in one place with his dogs for more than a week since continuous heavy rainfall hit Metro Manila. — Report from Rovy Jilyn Fraginal, Ryan Franco Verano, ABS-CBN News Interns
